import sys

def main():
    reader = sys.stdin
    reader.readline()  # skip first line
    line = reader.readline().strip()
    
    inParens = False
    token = []
    tokens = []
    maxLen = 0
    
    for pos in range(len(line)):
        current = line[pos]
        
        if current == '(':
            inParens = True
            maxLen = max(maxLen, len(token))
            token = []
        elif current == ')':
            inParens = False
            if len(token) > 0:
                tokens.append(''.join(token))
                token = []
        elif current == '_':
            if not inParens:
                maxLen = max(maxLen, len(token))
                token = []
            else:
                if len(token) > 0:
                    tokens.append(''.join(token))
                    token = []
        elif current.isalpha():
            token.append(current)
    
    maxLen = max(maxLen, len(token))
    
    print(f"{maxLen} {len(tokens)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
